scope: Rust and mixed-language performance for STAR

sources.title: Tokio spawn_blocking
sources.finding: Running blocking tasks are not stopped by abort; CPU tasks need bounded concurrency.
sources.star_decision: Use cooperative deadlines or isolated processes for hard termination, and separate CPU from I/O scheduling.

sources.title: Rayon ThreadPoolBuilder
sources.finding: A configurable worker pool can bound CPU parallelism.

sources.title: Reqwest Client
sources.finding: The client maintains a connection pool and is intended for reuse.

sources.title: Python asyncio runners

sources.title: SQLite FTS5

sources.title: SQLite write-ahead logging

sources.star_decision: Do not treat WAL as unlimited multiwriter concurrency or place its shared-memory design on a network filesystem.
